assertions.preferred_statement: fine-tuning geneformer significantly boosts predictive accuracy for transcription factor regulatory range compared to alternative methods.
tahoe-100m is the largest single-cell dataset to date enabling ai-driven models to learn context-dependent gene functions.

gears significantly outperforms all baseline methods in predicting single-gene perturbation transcriptional responses on both rpe-1 and k562 datasets with m.s.e. improvement of 30-50% and pearson correlation more than double that of baselines.
gears outperforms baseline methods in predicting two-gene perturbation outcomes across all generalization classes with over 30% improvement in m.s.e. and 50% greater enrichment for top de genes.
cellot outperforms current methods scgen cae popalign at predicting single-cell drug responses across both 4i and scrna-seq data modalities.
geneformer encodes network hierarchy in its attention weights in a completely self-supervised manner during pretraining.

scfoundation-based model for drug response prediction achieved high pearson and spearman correlations with higher clustering scores ch sil compared to gene expression baseline and enabled better transfer between bulk and single-cell data.
sci-plex can identify compounds that target convergent pathways by comparing single-cell transcriptional responses as evidenced by the similarity between mek and hsp90 inhibitor signatures.

gears significantly outperforms cpa in predicting non-additive combinatorial perturbation effects across multiple genetic interaction subtypes with correlation coefficients 0.4 vs 0.0 and precision 10 improvements >40% for four of five subtypes.
scfoundation outperformed imputation methods magic saver scimpute and scvi in clustering metrics nmi ari and sil on a human pancreatic islet dataset when t/s fold change was greater than 1.

the global transcriptional response to hdac inhibitors is consistent with induction of an acetyl-coa-deprived state as supported by upregulation of acetyl-coa synthesis enzymes and blocking of the response by acetyl-coa precursors.
cell line identity and cell cycle phase are the major factors driving stratification in the tahoe-100m transcriptomic data.
cellot captures cell-to-cell variability and heterogeneous subpopulation structures better than autoencoder-based methods.

tf binding patterns chip-seq support the model s predictions activating tfs targets are downregulated upon perturbation and repressors targets are upregulated genetic interactions are associated with co-binding.
in bmdcs transcription factors partition into five modules m1-m5 with distinct regulatory effects on lps-response programs p1-p5 including opposing regulation of alternative differentiation states.

scfoundation is a large-scale foundation model with 100 million parameters pretrained on over 50 million human single-cell transcriptomic profiles covering about 20 000 genes and achieves state-of-the-art performance across diverse downstream tasks including gene expression enhancement drug response prediction perturbation prediction and cell type annotation.

mimosca a regularized linear model with elastic net can estimate perturbation effects on gene expression while accounting for technical and biological covariates and can incorporate interaction terms.
cpa can be applied to combinatorial genetic perturbations and impute missing combinations.
scfoundation achieved the highest macro f1 score on cell type annotation tasks zheng68k and tm datasets with particular improvements in rare cell types.

none of the seven deep learning models scgpt scfoundation uce scbert geneformer gears cpa outperformed the additive baseline in predicting double perturbation effects none outperformed the no-change baseline in predicting genetic interactions.
in k562 cells perturb-seq reveals tf modules and cell-cycle regulator effects consistent with known biology and cell-state covariates improve reproducibility of tf-specific effects.
cellot can generalize to unseen patients in lupus ifn-β response prediction outperforming baselines in both i.i.d. and o.o.s. settings.
generalization of cellot to unseen patients requires similar samples in the unperturbed setting and similar perturbation responses in the training set.
crispr-mediated knockout of gsn and pln in ttn+/- cardiac microtissues significantly improves contractile stress validating them as therapeutic targets for dilated cardiomyopathy.
sci-plex enables high-throughput chemical screens at single-cell resolution profiling 650 000 cells across 5000 conditions in a single experiment.
in silico deletion of gata4 or tbx5 in fetal cardiomyocytes is more deleterious to their direct targets compared to indirect targets or housekeeping genes.

perturb-seq can scale to larger screens genome-wide or combinatorial screens are feasible with increasing cell throughput and computational bandwidth and future improvements e.g. cpf1 lineage tracing are compatible.
cpa can predict out-of-distribution drug combinations and outperforms baseline models.
dabrafenib elicits a stronger transcriptomic response in braf-mutated cell lines compared to kras-mutated or wild-type lines.
crispr-mediated knockout of tead4 in ipsc-derived cardiac microtissues causes a significant reduction in contractile stress.
sci-plex can distinguish cell-type-specific and shared transcriptional responses to compounds as exemplified by the distinct response of mek inhibitor trametinib in mcf7 versus a549 and k562 cells.
perturb-seq combines pooled crispr screens with single-cell rna-seq to dissect transcriptional effects of genetic perturbations at scale.
chemcpa outperforms cpa for combinatorial drug prediction when using chemical priors.
rmc-6236 shows a greater transcriptomic effect in kras-mutated cell lines than in wild-type lines.
none of the deep learning models gears scgpt uce scbert geneformer consistently outperformed the mean baseline or the linear model in predicting unseen single perturbation effects.
no single method performs well across all datasets in the perturbation generalization scenario.
sci-plex can quantify dose-dependent transcriptional responses to multiple compounds and infer viability scores concordant with gold standard measurements.
hdac inhibitor dose governs the magnitude rather than the rate of cellular response and heterogeneity in response cannot be solely attributed to asynchrony.
fine-tuning geneformer significantly boosts predictive accuracy for chromatin dynamics tasks compared to alternative methods.
the mosaic platform reduces batch effects and enables parallel profiling of thousands of conditions at single-cell resolution.
cpa significantly outperforms scgen in variance and whole distribution prediction.
no single method performs well across all datasets in the cellular context generalization scenario.
scfoundation gene context embeddings improve gears perturbation prediction performance reducing mse and better capturing top differential expression magnitude.
nuclear hashing using unmodified ssdna oligos stably labels nuclei and is compatible with sci-rna-seq enabling single-cell transcriptomic profiling of many samples in a single experiment.
cpa imputed 5 329 missing combinations in perturb-seq demonstrating applicability to genetic combinatorial screens.
